definitions.ask: How should machine-managed SDD integration treat a clone whose only problem is uncommitted edits?
definitions.why: Launch already evicts and re-clones sidecars, so stashing dirt buys little and risks owned work

choices.label: Never snapshot or reset plain dirt; only wedged git states self-heal
Still self-heal plain dirt in numbered workspaces that have no claim

definitions.ask: Should the finalizer's dirty-work-vanished error name the SDD recovery snapshot and its restore command?
definitions.why: Turns a silent loss into a one-command recovery for any remaining recovery path
